_about: The club's own facts, in one file a non-developer can edit from a phone. Everything the site asserts about the club is read from here (src/lib/content.ts); a fact that is not settled is a slot with `value: null` and the bracketed text that is waiting for a source, so the absence is explicit rather than invented. Rules this file answers to: DESIGN.md 'Copy' (state the fact, name where it came from, give a path out, carry the date; never state a frequency without a source; `[BRACKETS]` stay bracketed until a source exists), D92, D136 (no fabricated numbers), record 0010 (missing content is a designed state, never a blank and never a build failure).
_override: For a preview or a review build, copy src/content.local.example.json to src/content.local.json (gitignored, like .dev.vars) - it deep-merges over this file. Nothing tracked can turn a placeholder on: `scripts/check-content.mjs` fails any build that contains one, so a review-only state cannot reach the apex.

cadence.source: operator ruling, 2026-10-31, recorded in .notes/roadmap-events.md: 'Monthly is more generally correct; actual rhythm is ~every other week, occasionally skipped'
cadence.note: DESIGN.md forbids a frequency word with no source ('join us every week' survived two years). This one has a named source, which is what keeps it on the page. Set value to null and the copy falls back to naming the paths out instead of claiming a rhythm.

focus.placeholder: [what the club is actually reading, and since when]
focus.note: Pre-existing site copy, kept while it is confirmed. check:content lists it as an unsourced claim until source + asOf are filled; scripts/make-social-share.mjs reads the same value, so the share card and the hero cannot name two different current books.

schedule._source: the source of truth is ruled to be Mobilizon or an ICS feed (D132) and the operator has to provision one; until then no date on this page is knowable, so `upcoming` stays empty and the section renders its designed empty state (round 7, option A).

empty.title: No date is on the calendar yet.
empty.body: Dates are set in the club's Discord and posted on Meetup, where the calendar and the sign-up live. The discussion runs between meetings in the chat.

venueLine.placeholder: [venue blurb, one line - name, and what a first-timer should know about getting in]

venue.note: 'Local Library - Study Room B' was invented in the retired UpcomingMeetups.astro (see .notes/roadmap-events.md: 'entirely invented placeholder content'). It is not on the site and does not come back without a source.

membership.requires: the figure, where it came from, and the day it was counted (D136)
membership.note: The site used to render Math.floor(Math.random()*100+150)+'+ members'. A number that changes per request is not a statistic. Fill value + source + asOf and it ships as static copy; until then nothing is said.

photos._note: true draws measured shot-cards in the reserved photo places (PS-1, PS-3) so a preview shows the geometry a real photograph will take. It is only ever true in src/content.local.json: check:content fails a build whose HTML carries a placeholder fill.
